title: Red and blue
text: Flashing lights. The adult officer leans in: 'I can write this up — or you can make me forget it in my back seat.'

effects.tpl: You climb in — frantic mouth and hands, uniforms half-off, cumming fast while the radio crackles. Ticket vanishes. Shame lingers.
You take the $320 fine and keep your pants on. Boring. Clean.
